items.zh_title: 11月26日电商早报：SHEIN付1亿美元与FTC和解；唯品会三季度GMV422亿
items.zh_oneliner: SHEIN以1亿美元与美国FTC达成和解，唯品会三季度GMV达422亿元。
items.en_title: Nov 26 E-Commerce Morning Brief: SHEIN Pays $100M to Settle with FTC; Vipshop Q3 GMV Hits ¥42.2B
items.en_oneliner: SHEIN settled with the US FTC for $100 million, while Vipshop reported Q3 GMV of 42.2 billion yuan.

items.title: Molson Coors, Primo Brands use fuel hedging to tackle logistics costs
items.zh_title: Molson Coors 与 Primo Brands 用燃油对冲应对物流成本
items.zh_oneliner: 两家饮料公司用燃油对冲锁定物流成本，但专家提醒对冲也可能代价高昂、执行不易。
items.en_oneliner: The two beverage companies are hedging fuel costs to manage logistics spending, though experts warn hedging can be costly and hard to execute.

items.title: Readout of First Meeting of the Agricultural Working Group Under the Framework of the U.S.-China Board of Trade
items.zh_title: 中美商贸工作组框架下农业工作组首次会议纪要
items.zh_oneliner: 中美农业工作组首次开会，谈了农产品非关税壁垒、市场准入等议题。
items.en_oneliner: The U.S. and China held the first meeting of their Agricultural Working Group, discussing non-tariff barriers, market access and farm trade.

items.en_oneliner: Loctek's overseas warehouse revenue turned positive and gross margin improved, but analysts still disagree on why profits fell.

items.en_oneliner: By-health faces a bull-bear debate over Q4 margin pressure, falling pharmacy sales and rising expenses.

items.title: US readies tariffs over manufacturing capacity, production concerns
items.zh_title: 美国拟对中国等 15 个贸易伙伴加征 15%–35% 关税
items.zh_oneliner: 301 调查后拟议的新关税覆盖中国、欧盟等，卖家需重新核算对美出口成本。
items.en_oneliner: The US is preparing 15%–35% tariffs on goods from China, the EU and 12 other partners after a Section 301 probe — sellers should recheck landed costs.

items.title: Shein to pay $100M in FTC settlement over deceptive practices claims
items.zh_title: SHEIN 因涉嫌欺诈宣传与 FTC 达成 1 亿美元和解
items.zh_oneliner: FTC 指控 SHEIN 在快速发货承诺和商品评价展示等方面存在欺骗行为，卖家可借此看清平台合规红线。
items.en_oneliner: Shein agreed to pay $100M to settle FTC claims over fast-shipping promises and review practices — a compliance warning for sellers on major platforms.

items.en_title: Bear Electric Research Update: Overseas Segments and Roman Margins Under Pressure, Domestic Market Debate Unresolved
items.en_oneliner: Bear Electric's latest research shows its three overseas segments and Roman margins under pressure, with the debate over saturated domestic demand still unresolved.

items.title: PETA alleges animal abuse in PepsiCo’s supply chain
items.zh_title: PETA 指控百事公司供应链存在虐待动物行为
items.zh_oneliner: PETA 代表两名百事股东提交提案，称其食糖采购方式存在动物福利风险。
items.en_title: PETA alleges animal abuse in PepsiCo's supply chain
items.en_oneliner: PETA filed a shareholder proposal alleging PepsiCo's sugar sourcing practices pose risks to animal welfare.

items.title: Shoe Station flip flops on rebanner plan, again
items.zh_title: Shoe Station 换牌计划再次反转
items.zh_oneliner: 已改牌的 Shoe Station 门店将再次变回 Shoe Carnival，换牌计划反复横跳。
items.en_oneliner: Most rebannered Shoe Station stores will become Shoe Carnival stores again, reversing the rebranding plan.

items.title: California fines Afterpay $2.7M
items.zh_title: 加州因未评估还款能力对 Afterpay 罚款 270 万美元
items.zh_oneliner: 先买后付平台因未核查用户还款能力被罚，卖家接入分期支付时要留意合规要求。
items.en_oneliner: California fined Afterpay $2.7M for failing to assess borrowers' ability to repay — a compliance note for sellers offering buy-now-pay-later.

items.title: Illinois fights for interchange law
items.zh_title: 伊利诺伊州为刷卡手续费禁令法案据理力争
items.zh_oneliner: 伊利诺伊州总检察长向法院提交简报，力保禁止向刷卡手续费征税的州法，卡费成本走向值得卖家关注。
items.en_oneliner: Illinois' attorney general defended the state's interchange-fee law in court, a case that could affect card-processing costs for sellers.

items.title: Does This FBA SKU Actually Make Money?
items.zh_title: 这款 FBA 商品到底赚不赚钱？
items.zh_oneliner: 用完整周期和全部成本核算单品的真实利润，再决定要不要调价或清仓。
items.en_title: Does This FBA SKU Actually Make Money?
items.en_oneliner: Work out a single FBA SKU's true profit across a full period and all its costs before deciding whether to reprice or clear it.
